notes.title: Kingdom Of Peace Update to Version 1.0.2v!
Kingdom Of Peace Update to Version 1.0.1v!
🎉 Kingdom Of Peace - PREMIERE OF THE 1.0.0v VERSION! 🎉
notes.content:
[p][b]From Early Access to Full Release[/b] – thank you for being part of this journey
This is a very special moment for me: Kingdom Of Peace is officially leaving Early Access and becomes a full release with version 1.0.0v! I started working on this game completely alone back in 2022, and after nearly three years of hard work, testing, mistakes, learning, and many sleepless nights, we can now celebrate the end of this path together.

🎁 [b]Launch surprise![/b]
To celebrate version 1.0.0, [b]the price is permanently reduced from $10.99 to $3.99.[/b]
This isn’t just a gift for new players discovering Kingdom Of Peace, it’s a conscious decision. As a solo indie developer, I want the game to be more accessible to everyone. It was built for the community, with passion and dedication. To all those who supported the project from the beginning, thank you. This milestone wouldn’t have been possible without you.

🔨 [b]A brief development history[/b]
Version by version, month after month, step by step — it was possible to build something that today feels like a complete game with heart, soul, and ambition.

🛠️ [b]Major milestones:[/b]
[/p][olist][*][p][b]0.2.0v[/b] – NPC dialogues, moral choices, gold and level system, combat tutorial, first RPG mechanics.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]0.2.5v[/b] – huge technical leap: [b]migration from UE4 to Unreal Engine 5[/b], world-building improvements, English voice acting, Polish translation, health bar, first Steam achievements.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]0.3.0v[/b] – the breakthrough update:
[b]New realm[/b] – a large open map inspired by Poland,
[b]7 towns, 5 bandit camps, 5 hidden treasures,[/b]
[b]Story conclusion[/b] and your own village (narratively),
[b]New translations[/b] (French, German, Italian, Czech, and more), [b]40 achievements, hunger & thirst system, wild animal hunting,[/b] [b]Crossbow, horse riding, day/night cycle,[/b] fall damage, full character body.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]0.3.3v[/b] – [b]option to skip the prologue[/b] for those who prefer jumping straight into the adventure.

🏰 [b]What’s included in the full version?[/b]
[list][*][p] Complete storyline with an ending,
[/p][/*][*][p] Large world with unique locations, secrets, and events,
[/p][/*][*][p] Survival mechanics (hunger, thirst),
[/p][/*][*][p] Horse riding, combat, hunting, moral choices,
[/p][/*][*][p] Dialogues, translations, voice acting,
[/p][/*][*][p] Steam achievements and multilingual support.
[/p][/*][/list]
🌱 [b]What’s next?[/b]
Although [b]Kingdom Of Peace[/b] has now reached its full version, that doesn’t mean I’m done with creating. On the contrary — recent months helped me rethink many things and start shaping new ideas. There’s nothing official to announce just yet… but something is taking shape. Quiet concepts are turning into something more, and the inspiration is still the same passion that gave birth to [b]Kingdom Of Peace[/b].

If you’d like to be part of the next adventure — stay tuned.
The best is yet to come.

❤️ [b]Thank you all![/b]
– Rafał Tchórznicki – Prosuntal Games Studio and Kingdom Of Peace creator.


[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Kingdom of Peace update to version 0.3.3v!
notes.content:
What's been added:

[list]
[*] Option to skip the game's prologue
[/list]

[i]This feature is especially useful for players who found tasks like gathering flowers or cleaning a neighbor’s house in exchange for essential items at the start of the game boring. That’s how the story was designed to progress, but I understand that not everyone enjoyed it. So, I came up with a solution and added an option to skip it. :)

Now, with a single click, you can bypass the game's introduction and jump straight into the action—starting from the outbreak of war and managing your own settlement.[/i]

notes.title: Kingdom Of Peace massive update to version 0.3.0v
notes.content:
[p][b]What was added:[/b]

[/p][olist][*][p] Completion of the plot
[/p][/*][*][p] Running your own village (This is related to the plot, and the construction of the village is not optional in the sense that we cannot build buildings wherever we want, it is more linear but equally interesting)
[/p][/*][*][p] New Land (Large open map inspired by Poland)
Containing, among others:
7 towns (2 villages, 3 cities, 1 castle, 1 town), 5 bandit camps (2 - level one, 1 - level two, 2 - level 3), 5 treasures scattered throughout the map.
[/p][/*][*][p] Map of the new land
[/p][/*][*][p] Completely changed game graphics
[/p][/*][*][p] New game translations: Czech, French, German, Swedish, Hungarian, Italian
[/p][/*][*][p] New achievements (increased from 7 to 40) [/p][/*][*][p] New mechanics
[/p][/*][*][p] Hunger and thirst system
[/p][/*][*][p] Possibility of hunting game such as: wild boar, deer, roe deer, hare
[/p][/*][*][p] New weapon: crossbow (Can be obtained from bandits - crossbowmen)
[/p][/*][*][p] More sounds
[/p][/*][*][p] Opening the door manually (Clicking the interaction button) and not automatically as before. 
[/p][/*][*][p] Fall damage
[/p][/*][*][p] Hero's body
[/p][/*][*][p] Horse riding mechanics and everything related to it, e.g. summoning a mount by whistling, etc.
[/p][/*][*][p] Day and night cycle (available in the last map with free mode)
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved hud
[/p][/*][*][p] Game optimization
[/p][/*][*][p] Bug fixes
[/p][/*][/olist][p]\[/letter]
[b]- I guess that's all... I honestly don't know, because during almost half a year when I was making this update, I added a lot and I might have forgotten something ;)

Thank you for your patience with the update and I hope you enjoy it.[/b]









[/p]

[*] *Achievements on Steam
[*] *New animations and sounds
[*] *Improved optimization
[*] *Improved dialogue issues
[*] *New decorations on maps
[*] *Changed interface
[*] *And other news
[/list]


[b]- I'm not sure if I wrote everything down, if I missed something, I'm sorry :)[/b]

notes.title: Create quests for "KOP"
notes.content: Hello, I just came up with an idea to organize a competition for you in which the winner will be the person who creates (5) best side quests for Kingdom Of Peace, i.e. for my game, you can win a code for a copy of "Kingdom Of Peace" on Steam, i.e. by winning the competition you can [b]save 10 dollars;)[/b] What should be included in your work? The answer is simple, you have to write what the quests are about and write a simple description for them. These are the main requirements, but if you want to add something, write :) after all, it's fun. You can send your works to my email: [b]bycgraczembiznes@gmail.com[/b] And I will choose them from among the others and put them into the game (the rest will not be wasted and I will add them later) The competition lasts until Saturday, [b]April 20, 2024[/b], and the video with thanks and the announcement of the winning person will be posted on Monday, [b]April 22, 2024[/b]. on the [b]YouTube platform[/b] on the "[b]Byc Graczem[/b]" channel
